Requirement_Description: Applied steering feedback gains must reside strictly within the certified Lyapunov stability envelope for current operating conditions
Gain adjustments between consecutive grid knots must be rate-limited by gain_hop_period to prevent transient destabilization
Candidate RL gain proposals must be checked against absolute parameter bounds and maximum rate of change prior to admission
Commended vehicle speed must be capped to ensure lateral acceleration demand does not exceed available friction limits (v <= sqrt(a_y_max / kappa))
Steering angle commands must be saturated at the physical tire adhesion limit delta_max(v, mu, m)
Steering slew rate commands must be capped by envelope-certified rate limits to prevent actuator saturation
Actuator tracking error between commanded and measured angle must be monitored to detect delayed or stuck actuators
The supervisor must escalate to DEGRADED_ACTUATOR mode when effective delay tau exceeds threshold and adopt conservative envelope cells
Yaw rate sensor measurements must be checked against dynamic bicycle model predictions to detect tire blowout or model inconsistency
The supervisor must transition to FALLBACK mode upon persistent actuator or yaw residuals and latch until recover period passes
Operating conditions outside envelope coverage or below friction floor (mu < mu_floor) must immediately trigger MINIMAL_RISK safe stop
Minimal risk mode must latch and only clear upon explicit reset signal after healthy_for continuous operation exceeds stale_grace
Stand-alone C99 embedded deployment must operate with zero dynamic heap allocation (0 B malloc/calloc/free) and deterministic latency (< 100 us)
